name: gimp
local_changes: Build the self-contained 3.2.8 release tarball instead of the GIMP_3_2_8 git tag plus a floating gimp-data checkout; drop the git makedepend and submodule wiring.
Pin .so depends to the provisions these repositories publish and keep upstream's bare forms where the provider publishes only bare sonames or none.
Pin libjxl to the 0.12 provisions this tree publishes.
Name xz's liblzma.so provision instead of repeating liblcms2.so.
Disable AppStream validation with -Dappdata-test=disabled instead of deleting the check from desktop/meson.build.
Compile en_US.UTF-8 inside the build tree because gen-languages needs a UTF-8 locale and the isolated root ships only C.utf8.
Drop the obsolete gimp.install upgrade notice and increment pkgrel to 2.2.
